digest.component_or_area: code_health metrics composition and adapter integration
propositions: Lizard and jscpd adapter outputs are not currently wired into registered code_health metrics, making them dead code.
The metrics evaluation must invoke each external analyzer (scc, lizard, jscpd) at most once per context via a per-invocation cache keyed by producer name and immutable inputs.
Missing or unavailable analyzers must yield an honest Unavailable outcome naming the missing producer, not zeros or generic error strings.
Registered structural complexity_summary and duplication_summary metric specs must expose normalized adapter payloads or propagate Unavailable semantics.
Python and Go fixture projects must expose loc, complexity, and duplication values through the metrics entry point when tools are available, and clear Unavailable entries when producers are absent.
